scenario: Researcher asks about methods, datasets and experimental results in a selected real paper.
source: Official QASPER v0.3 train, original article text/abstract/captions and independent human question/answer/evidence annotations.
sample_role: Non-formal development scenario; sampled train data, no new holdout claim. All selected questions retained including mixed annotation case.
primary_population: scorable consensus answerable/unanswerable; mixed annotation question reported separately and in official-style descriptive all-question score.
primary: Best human-reference answer token F1, invalid/provider/workflow errors retained as0; group-paired95 percentile bootstrap by paper,5000 draws.
secondary: human evidence paragraph overlap and exact-visible-text coverage
real Run completion and persisted model/tool counts
all observed usage, missing usage, unknown currency cost
comparison: One frozen compound existing production scene preset: generic final5/default RAG5000 versus final10/RAG8000/full-evidence byte filling8000. Same chunking/index/model/prompt. No prompt/LLM-selector variants or parameter sweep.
ingestion: KnowledgeService upload of faithful paper Markdown -> production ingestion worker entry point, invoked inline -> real BGE embeddings and tokenizer sparse adapter -> isolated Qdrant; no supplied candidate or gold chunk indexing.
runtime: Normal AgentPublishService creates2 immutable PINNED versions per paper, then AgentRunService invokes actual model-tool-model with production ToolRuntime and SQL/Qdrant retriever; record final admitted model messages.
run_order: Round-robin fixed source questions; for each question random seeded arm order, sequential real runs. First pair remains part of planned score and is used for interface inspection only.
stop: Unknown outcome, wrong model, non400 provider error or cross-paper source violation stop future runs, no retry. Eight failed runs stop dispatch. All planned cases retained. No automatic completion amendment. A SUCCEEDED Run missing the mandatory single real search also stops the experiment.
gate_basis: Engineering usefulness thresholds, not a powered general claim.12 papers/42questions and only3 consensus unanswerables cannot certify population faithfulness, refusal or business readiness.
pricing: Provider quote unavailable; keep observed usage and missing usage explicitly. Unknown amounts remain null, never0; request/output ceilings bound the experiment. No invented monetary costs.
limitations: Text dataset captures, not original PDF/OCR/figure/table-cell comprehension
Inline actual ingestion worker function, no Celery broker scheduling acceptance
Service-layer real Run, not public HTTP/browser UI/full deployment/checkpoint-resume acceptance
Evidence paragraph matching is not semantic entailment or calibrated claim faithfulness
Different scene and answer types from previous MuSiQue, no score trend splicing

pre_answer_clarifications.source: integration-review.json and actual dataset scorer preflight
notes: Strict global dispatch counter shared across runs
Missing required real search halts after the recorded invalid workflow; no final-answer credit
Non-refusal requires visible citations; refusal requires no citations
Preserve raw wrong-model versus transport-unknown outcomes independently of production normalized failures
Caption-origin and whitespace-only metadata preparation are offline only; uploaded source text unchanged
Mixed case is descriptive even when scorable=false

_publication.policy: case text, source corpus, requests, credentials and per-case objects omitted
